name: Google Services
description: Each person links their own Google account: calendar, mail, tasks, contacts, Drive and health, shown only to the person Nuxiva recognises.
capabilities: Drive file retrieval and cloud backup

guide.title: How to get the Google Client ID and Client Secret
steps: Open Google Cloud Console and sign in with the Google account that will administer Nuxiva.
Open the project picker at the top, choose “New project”, name it “Nuxiva”, press Create and make sure it stays selected.
Enable the APIs below: open each link, check that the Nuxiva project is selected at the top and press “Enable”. Without an enabled API that service answers “API not enabled”.
Open Google Auth Platform › Branding: app name “Nuxiva”, your support email and the developer email, then Save.
Open Audience: user type “External”. Under “Test users” add the Google address of everyone who will link their account (up to 100).
Open Data access › “Add or remove scopes”, paste the scope list below into “Manually add scopes”, press Add and then Save.

Open Clients › “Create client”, application type “Desktop app”, name “Nuxiva”, then Create. No redirect URI is needed: Nuxiva uses http://127.0.0.1:8889/, which Google accepts automatically for desktop apps.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the dialog, paste them below and press Save.

Each person links their own account from the Identity Manager: open their record, Connectors, Google, pick the services and authorise. If Google shows “Google hasn't verified this app”, press “Advanced” and then “Go to Nuxiva”: this is normal for a personal app. Keep every box ticked.
At the end the browser opens a page that does not load (127.0.0.1): copy the full address from the bar and paste it into Nuxiva within 30 minutes.

Google Health is authorized separately: Google does not accept health permissions together with Gmail, Calendar and the other services. After linking Google, switch on «Google Health» (and «activity and sleep»): a second authorization opens with only the health permissions.
For health data the person must use the Google Health app on their phone with the same Google account and have created a profile (or migrated their Fitbit account), otherwise Google returns no data.

items.label: Google Health API
items.detail: heart rate, HRV, oxygen, blood pressure, glucose, weight, steps and sleep

copy.label: OAuth scopes to add under “Data access”

guide.note: In “Testing” mode Google expires the authorisation every 7 days: to avoid it, press “Publish app” in Audience. An unverified personal app works for up to 100 users and shows the unverified app warning. The Client Secret is private: never share it. Google Keep cannot be linked this way: Google only grants it to Google Workspace Enterprise organisations through a service account with domain-wide delegation, so do not add the …/auth/keep scope (Google rejects it).

help.NUXIVA_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com. Find it under Credentials, OAuth client ID.
help.NUXIVA_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: Private string starting with GOCSPX-, shown next to the Client ID.
